subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

BGL : HNT :: EIM : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• (+6) is added the first letter's position value.
 
• (+7) is added the second letter's position value.
 
• (+8) is added the third letter's position value.

So,

 
• BGL : HNT

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea7caf1986329abef95289cd3b1435e553a8c5710569bdeadca11223a80c9a19.png] 

Similarly,

 
• EIM : ?​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f2084e37cff66cc3c1a973fcd107d4d4c8874da8dc2059a0eed4b95a11421be.png] 

Hence, **"KPU"** is the correct answer.

b5
